name: d1_base_rate_v1
purpose: D1 BASE RATE. Establish whether the omission REPRODUCES, and at what rate, before any further discrimination. Three discrimination rounds were run against a defect whose stability was never confirmed; the in-run baseline of round 2 then failed to reproduce it (0/3 zero-record against a pooled history of ~14/17). n=8 per case, first run under a PINNED config recorded in the output.

cases.message: Five Guys Little Cheeseburger and a small fries
cases.label_note: = corpus case 2, VERBATIM. Pooled history: 7/8 asks zero-record.

cases.message: Panda Express Bigger Plate: Orange Chicken, Teriyaki Chicken, and Super Greens
cases.label_note: = corpus case 3, VERBATIM. Pooled history: 7/9 asks zero-record.

cases.message: 8 oz sirloin, a loaded baked potato, and a Caesar salad
cases.label_note: = corpus case 16. CONTROL: emitted records 12/12 asks across four runs.

interpretation_frozen_before_run.one_reproduces: D1 NARROWS to the reproducing case before any new criterion work.
interpretation_frozen_before_run.neither_reproduces: D1 is NOT an active defect population under the current tree/config. DEMOTE it until a new occurrence appears.
interpretation_frozen_before_run.prior_rounds: NO semantic, form or chain conclusions may be drawn from rounds 1-2. Their in-run baseline failed to reproduce and those runs were NOT config-pinned, so their comparisons are void - not merely weak.
interpretation_frozen_before_run.material: MECHANICAL, NOT A JUDGEMENT CALL. Derived from the control, not from the subject counts, and fixed before any count was read.
interpretation_frozen_before_run.threshold_derivation: The control emitted records on 12 of 12 asks: 0/12 zero-record. By the rule of three, the 95% upper bound on a rate observed as 0/12 is 3/12 = 25%. So an omission rate at or below 25% is INSIDE the control's plausible range and is not reproduction. Over 8 asks, 25% is 2. Hence the cut at >=3.

decision_rule.denominator: ASKS, never turns. A logged turn is not evidence about omission.
decision_rule.REPRODUCES: >= 3 of 8 asks zero-record (> 25%, above the control's rule-of-three bound)
decision_rule.DOES_NOT_REPRODUCE: <= 2 of 8 asks zero-record (within the control's bound)
decision_rule.INSUFFICIENT: fewer than 4 asks in 8 turns -> UNDER-POWERED, declare insufficient rather than forcing a call. Round 2 died of exactly this: c303 asked once and c301 not at all.
decision_rule.CONTROL_INVALID: if control case 403 shows ANY zero-record ask, the run is void - the threshold is derived from it
